narrative.overview: The analysis is a ticket wallet: the method is a coupon book whose legs tear off in order, a case path reads as an itinerary whose layovers are the waits, and every proposal is a coupon with fixed fields that the analyst's decision stamps; nothing disappears, it cancels.
keyCharacteristics: Navy coupon heads in Archivo's condensed width; the open leg is navy.
Carbon-copy cobalt on figures, layover bars, evidence IDs and the ESTIMATE copy.
The ESTIMATE torn off below a perforation on a pale cobalt carbon sheet.
Signal red only for stamps and bad news; green only for approved and sound.
Flat at rest; light and dark as equals; true near-black dark ground.

rules.name: The Carbon-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks data and the ESTIMATE copy; chrome keeps ink labels.

rules.name: The Nothing-Disappears Rule
rules.body: Rejected rounds stay in the decision log, voided, never deleted.
